name: hermes-remote
description: Secure Android-to-Hermes relay through an HK gateway and macOS connector

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hermes-remote/protocol && npm run build -w @hermes-remote/gateway && npm run build -w @hermes-remote/connector
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hermes-remote/protocol && npm run test -w @hermes-remote/connector && npm run test -w @hermes-remote/gateway && npm run test -w @hermes-remote/release-server
